metadata.name: pepper_curve
metadata.description: Pepper (pepper.fan) on-chain bonding curve: strip-proof atomic creator and platform fee split, presale curve, creator vesting, and merkle dividend distributor. Graduation hands off to a Raydium CPMM pool.

accounts.name: fanex
docs: and Fanex's share of the raise, in one transfer.

instructions.name: buy_exact_in
docs: Spend at most `usdc_in` µUSDC for at least `min_tokens_out` tokens: the
math crate's `quote_buy`, moved exactly by `transfer_checked`, over 13
fixed accounts in the order a router's metas are built in. A partial fill
at graduation charges less than `usdc_in`.

accounts.name: user_transfer_authority
docs: 0. The user, or a router's program authority: the only signer, and not the fee payer.

accounts.name: user_source_usdc
docs: 1. The USDC that pays, owned by account 0.

accounts.name: user_destination_token
docs: 2. Where the tokens go: any owner, but inside the launch window only account 0's associated
token account of the mint (`LaunchDestinationNotOwnAta`, checked in the handler).

accounts.name: usdc_config
docs: 3. The USDC side's config: its pause, its mint and its fee account.

accounts.name: curve
docs: 4. A `CurveUsdc` by its type: a SOL `Curve` here is refused by its discriminator (3002).

accounts.name: usdc_vault
docs: 5. The curve's reserve, a PDA token account whose authority is the curve. Its balance is never
read: the price runs on the curve's counters, so USDC sent straight to it moves nothing.

accounts.name: token_vault
docs: 6. The tokens for sale: the curve PDA's associated token account of the mint.

accounts.name: fee_usdc_account
docs: 7. The fee wallet's USDC account: the 1% fee and Fanex's raise share, in one transfer.

accounts.name: creator_usdc_account
docs: 8. The creator's USDC account, where the creator's raise share is paid. Required, by the
curve's counters, exactly while the creator's cap is open (`creator_usdc_account_required`,
`CreatorUsdcAccountInvalid` without it); otherwise accepted if passed, still bound to the
curve's record, and paid only a non-zero share.

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: 9. The USDC mint the config names, for `transfer_checked`.

accounts.name: token_mint
docs: 10. The curve's token mint, for `transfer_checked`.

accounts.name: launch_guard_waiver
docs: 11. The curve's `LaunchGuardWaiver`, read only where the launch cap would refuse
(`validation::launch_guard_waived`: the program's account, the waiver's discriminator, the
curve's mint, its PDA), as `buy` reads its waiver; anything else passed here lifts nothing. A
typed account would be read and seed-checked whenever passed.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: 12. Classic SPL Token: USDC and the curve's token are both classic mints.

accounts.name: rent_payer
docs: Funds the `ClaimStatus` rent (~0.00128 SOL). In the ordinary flow this
is the Fanex sponsor wallet, which already co-signs the claim tx as its
fee payer — so a holder pays NOTHING to claim, and a 0-SOL wallet is no
longer stuck. The client falls back to `rent_payer = claimant` when no
sponsor key is configured; the program accepts any signer here because
paying rent grants no authority — the proof and the seeds still bind
everything to `claimant`.

accounts.name: claim_status
docs: Existence marks this wallet as having claimed. `init` fails if it already
exists → a wallet can claim its allocation exactly once.

accounts.name: claimant
docs: Signs, as in v1: the claim is a pull, and only the holder pulls. Who pays
the fee is the transaction's business; there is no rent to pay.

instructions.name: claim_vesting_usdc
docs: `claim_vesting` on a `CurveUsdc`: the same schedule and the same lock,
a curve created from 2026-11-01 released once its pool exists
(PoolCreated or Graduated); the beneficiary's token account must exist,
and the tokens move by `transfer_checked`.

accounts.name: curve
docs: A `CurveUsdc` by its type: a SOL `Curve` here is refused by its discriminator (3002), as
the SOL `claim_vesting` refuses this one.

accounts.name: beneficiary_token_account
docs: The beneficiary's associated token account of the mint, still owned by the beneficiary;
missing, the claim is refused (`AccountNotInitialized`), never opened at their expense.

accounts.name: claim_status
docs: pre-upgrade, 88-byte with `rent_payer`) and `Account<ClaimStatus>` can
only read the new one; owner, discriminator and seeds are all verified
in the handler.

accounts.name: distributor
docs: DEAD (its account closed): while the distributor lives, the ClaimStatus
is the double-claim guard and closing it would re-open the claim.

accounts.name: rent_recipient
docs: on the new format, `claimant` on the legacy one — so a permissionless
caller can trigger the refund but never redirect it.

instructions.name: close_creator_raise_usdc
docs: Close a USDC curve's creator raise at what it has received, signed by `UsdcConfig.admin`:
its buys then need no creator USDC account, so one frozen or lost stops nothing. Bonding
only, never paused.

accounts.name: admin
docs: `UsdcConfig.admin` (`Unauthorized` for any other key, the pauser included).

accounts.name: curve
docs: A `CurveUsdc` by its type and its seeds: a SOL `Curve` is refused by its discriminator (3002).

instructions.name: close_expired_distributor
docs: Close an expired v1 month to its recorded funder, permissionless, so no month blocks its
address past its expiry.

accounts.name: distributor
docs: A v1 month, closed to its recorded funder.

accounts.name: funder
docs: lamports and need not sign.

instructions.name: close_expired_distributor_v2
docs: `close_expired_distributor` for a v2 month.

accounts.name: distributor
docs: A v2 month, closed to its recorded funder.

accounts.name: funder
docs: lamports and need not sign.

accounts.name: launcher
docs: Pays for all account creation and signs the tx. In creator mode this is
the creator themselves; in admin-concierge mode this is the admin
launching on the creator's behalf.

accounts.name: creator
docs: every buy and beneficiary of the vested 2%. Stored as `curve.creator` and
later enforced by `buy`/`sell`/`claim_vesting`. MAY differ from `launcher`
(admin-concierge). No signature is required: whoever pays the create tx
designates the creator wallet.

accounts.name: mint
docs: New SPL mint (fresh keypair, signs for its own init). Authority is set to
the curve PDA, then revoked after the one-time supply mint.

accounts.name: token_vault
docs: Holds the curve-sale + migration tokens (ATA of the curve PDA).

accounts.name: vesting_vault
docs: Holds the vested creator tokens (PDA token account of the curve PDA).

accounts.name: metadata
docs: the Metaplex CPI in the handler derives + validates it against `mint` and
creates it. Mutable because the CPI initializes it.

accounts.name: metadata_update_authority
docs: `config.admin` (2026-10-24, the fee-wallet split, docs/ops/KEY-ROTATION.md
§1e), the key that can fix name/symbol/uri later, the upgrade Squad's vault
once `GlobalConfig.admin` moves there (docs/security/MULTISIG.md §6), never
the receive-only fee wallet. It was `config.fanex_fee_wallet` until then.

instructions.name: create_curve_usdc
docs: Launch a USDC curve, paid and signed by `UsdcConfig.launcher` alone (the
sponsor): today's checks in µUSDC, the creator's USDC ATA with a creator
split, the supply into the two vaults, the Metaplex metadata under
`UsdcConfig.admin`, the mint authority revoked. No USDC moves.

accounts.name: payer
docs: The sponsor, `UsdcConfig.launcher` (`Unauthorized` for any other key): signs and pays every
rent, so a creator spends no SOL and no stranger launches terms the screens never state.

accounts.name: creator
docs: need not sign. With a creator split it may not be the fan-led placeholder
(`PlaceholderCannotRaise`), and its USDC ATA is the one the split is paid into.

accounts.name: mint
docs: The new token, a fresh keypair signing for its own `init`: its mint authority the curve PDA,
revoked after the one-time mint, and no freeze authority.

accounts.name: curve
docs: At `["curve", mint]`, where a SOL `Curve` would sit: a mint has one or the other.

accounts.name: usdc_vault
docs: The curve's USDC reserve: a token account of `usdc_mint` at its own PDA, the curve its
authority, not an ATA (§10.2).

accounts.name: token_vault
docs: The tokens for sale and for the pool, as today: the curve PDA's associated account.

accounts.name: vesting_vault
docs: The creator's vested tokens, as today.

accounts.name: creator_usdc_account
docs: The creator's USDC associated token account, closable by the payer alone: required with a
creator split and refused without one (`CreatorUsdcAccountInvalid` either way, checked in
the handler by `creator_usdc_account_to_store`). Absent, it is passed as the program's own
id. Only read: the launch transaction opens and hardens it before this instruction.

accounts.name: metadata
docs: checks it against the mint, and creates it.

accounts.name: metadata_update_authority
docs: before the first USDC launch (Rick, 2026-10-22), where a SOL launch names the fee wallet.
Metaplex keeps it for good, so the hot key that signed `initialize_usdc_config` hands the
admin over first.

accounts.name: token_metadata_program
docs: `Program<Metadata>` checks it is executable with the accounts, before the handler, so no
refusal below could run where Metaplex is not loaded.

instructions.name: graduate_usdc_lock
docs: Lock a pooled curve's whole LP in Raydium's LP lock, by CPI: the pool creator's
LP balance, the LP mint and the pool's vaults as the pool's own `PoolState`
records them, the Fee Key to `UsdcConfig.lp_fee_owner`, the lock's rents paid by
the pool creator, funded by the caller, `extra_lamports` (at most 0.1 SOL) included,
and emptied back to it. Permissionless, gated by both USDC pauses; PoolCreated to
Graduated, the reserve counters zeroed.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone, the keeper by default: hands the pool creator what the lock's accounts cost, and
gets back what the lock does not spend.

accounts.name: usdc_config
docs: The USDC side's config: its pause, the lock and its authority, the Fee Key's owner.

accounts.name: curve
docs: A `CurveUsdc` by its type: a SOL `Curve` here is refused by its discriminator (3002).

accounts.name: pool_creator
docs: The pool's creator, `["pool_creator", mint]`, the LP's owner since `graduate_usdc_pool`:
pays the lock's rents from what the caller hands it, and signs the CPI as the lock's payer
and as the liquidity's owner.

accounts.name: pool_creator_lp
docs: the LP, and no other account the pool creator may own.

accounts.name: lock_program
docs: Raydium's LP lock, the program the LP goes into.

accounts.name: lock_authority
docs: PDA, the owner of its LP vault.

accounts.name: fee_nft_mint
docs: mint there with no seeds of its own, so the program signs for it.

accounts.name: fee_nft_account
docs: lock creates and checks.

accounts.name: pool_state
docs: the handler as the `PoolState` its CPMM wrote, whichever CPMM the config names now.

accounts.name: locked_liquidity
docs: lock creates and checks.

accounts.name: locked_lp_vault
docs: when missing and checks.

accounts.name: metadata_account
docs: it only when asked for metadata, never here (`with_metadata = false`), and does not check it
then (LiteSVM: any address passes), so the program binds it rather than hand the lock a
writable account the caller chose.

instructions.name: graduate_usdc_pool
docs: Create a graduating curve's Raydium CPMM pool, by CPI, at the program's PDA
`["cpmm_pool", mint]`: the counted reserves, never the vaults' balances, through
the pool creator, a system-owned PDA of ours that pays Raydium's rents and fee,
funded by the caller, `extra_lamports` (at most 0.1 SOL) included, and emptied back
to it. Permissionless, gated by both USDC pauses; Graduating to PoolCreated.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone, the keeper by default: pays the pool creator's two ATAs where they do not exist yet,
and hands the pool creator what CPMM charges, getting back what it does not spend.

accounts.name: usdc_config
docs: The USDC side's config: its pause, its mint and the Raydium addresses the CPI goes to.

accounts.name: curve
docs: A `CurveUsdc` by its type: a SOL `Curve` here is refused by its discriminator (3002).

accounts.name: usdc_vault
docs: The curve's USDC reserve, by its seeds: `real_usdc_reserves` leaves it, never its balance.

accounts.name: token_vault
docs: The curve's tokens, the curve PDA's associated account: `real_token_reserves +
migration_token_reserves` leave it, never its balance.

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: The USDC mint the config names, for `transfer_checked` and the pool.

accounts.name: token_mint
docs: The curve's token mint, for `transfer_checked` and the pool.

accounts.name: pool_creator
docs: The pool's creator, `["pool_creator", mint]`: a system-owned PDA with no data, since CPMM
takes its rents and its fee from the creator's lamports by System transfers, which the curve,
an account with data, could not make. Signs the CPI.

accounts.name: pool_creator_usdc
docs: The pool creator's USDC ATA: an ATA's address fixes its owner and its mint, so one a
stranger opened first is the same account, taken as it is. anchor-spl's CPI names the ATA it
derives from the pool creator and the mint, so any other account here fails it
(`MissingAccount`) before a token moves.

accounts.name: pool_creator_token
docs: The pool creator's ATA of the curve's token, as `pool_creator_usdc`.

accounts.name: cpmm_program
docs: Raydium's CPMM, the program the reserves go into.

accounts.name: amm_config
docs: The CPMM's 1% fee tier, `usdc_config.raydium_amm_config`, still at 1% and creating pools.

accounts.name: pool_state
docs: the program signing for it.

accounts.name: pool_creator_lp
docs: creator and the LP mint), read after the CPI for the LP the pool minted.

accounts.name: create_pool_fee
docs: (`create_pool_fee_reveiver::ID`), so the program takes it as given (2026-10-24): a pin to
`usdc_config.raydium_create_pool_fee` refused every graduation for the 48 hours a config
change takes, should Raydium move it, and the fee is the caller's lamports, never a curve's.
The wrapped-SOL account Raydium takes its pool-creation fee into.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: Classic SPL Token: USDC and the curve's token are both classic mints, so it is CPMM's
`token_program`, `token_0_program` and `token_1_program` alike.

accounts.name: curve
docs: The curve for `mint`. Derived from the mint, so a distributor can't be
opened for a non-existent curve. Until 2026-10-05 it also authorized the
creator as a v1 funder; a creator now funds only in v2, with Fanex's
approval (`InitDistributorV2::approver`). Kept so the account list, and
every client built on it, does not move.

accounts.name: approver
docs: Fanex's approval of what this month commits (2026-10-05): the signature of
`config.graduation_authority`, the server's key, since 2026-10-24 (the
fee-wallet split; the fee wallet's until then), given on the transaction
the server prepared, so the root, total and expiry are the ones Fanex
planned even when the creator funds and sends it. It approves only: it is
not written and pays nothing. Never a funder: the dividend payer and the
creator fund, so neither key alone, stolen, opens a month.

accounts.name: curve
docs: The curve for `mint`, read only for the funder gate, as in `InitDistributor`.

accounts.name: distributor
docs: The same seeds as a v1 `Distributor`: a month takes one distributor,
whichever its version, and `init` fails while either exists. The funder
pays the registry once, inside this account's rent.

instructions.name: initialize_usdc_config
docs: Create the USDC side's config, signed by the program's upgrade authority as
its ProgramData records it, naming its first admin (a system-owned account,
the upgrade Squad's vault on mainnet): the USDC mint (6 decimals, set once),
the fee wallet's hardened USDC ATA, the keys of `params`, the Raydium fields
all-zero.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Pays the config's rent: on mainnet the vault itself, since a vault transaction carries no
other keypair's signature.

accounts.name: upgrade_authority
docs: The program's upgrade authority, as its ProgramData records it. Not `GlobalConfig.admin`.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: The program's ProgramData, the upgradeable loader's PDA of the program id (`ConstraintSeeds`
anywhere else, so another program's ProgramData, whoever holds it, is refused), owned by the
loader, whose `upgrade_authority_address` must be the signer: `Unauthorized` for any other
key, `GlobalConfig.admin` included, for an immutable program, which records none, and for a
program loaded without the upgradeable loader, which has no ProgramData. `set_usdc_raydium`'s
gate, read the same way.

accounts.name: admin
docs: The first `UsdcConfig.admin`: an account the system program owns, as a Squads vault is
(`AccountNotSystemOwned` otherwise, the all-zero key included, which is the system program's
own). The multisig account is the Squads program's and never signs: an admin handed to it
would be lost for good (MULTISIG.md §2).

accounts.name: global_config
docs: Read for one key, the fee wallet the fee account must belong to.

accounts.name: usdc_config
docs: A plain `init`: a second initialize fails on the account already there.

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: A classic SPL mint of 6 decimals (`ConstraintMintDecimals` otherwise), set once: no
instruction changes it after this one.

accounts.name: fee_usdc_account
docs: The fee wallet's USDC account: of `usdc_mint` (`ConstraintTokenMint` otherwise), owned by
`GlobalConfig.fanex_fee_wallet` (`AccountMismatch` otherwise), then held in the handler to
`fee_usdc_account_valid` (`FeeUsdcAccountInvalid`): the wallet's ATA, not frozen, closable
by this config's PDA alone.

instructions.name: sell_exact_in
docs: Sell `tokens_in` for at least `min_usdc_out` µUSDC after the 1% fee: the
math crate's `quote_sell`, the proceeds and the fee out of `usdc_vault`
by `transfer_checked`, the curve signing, over 11 fixed accounts in the
order a router's metas are built in.

accounts.name: user_transfer_authority
docs: 0. The user, or a router's program authority: the only signer, and not the fee payer.

accounts.name: user_source_token
docs: 1. The tokens sold, owned by account 0: a delegate of the owner is refused.

accounts.name: user_destination_usdc
docs: 2. Where the proceeds go: any USDC account, any owner, inside the launch window too (a sale
has no launch rule).

accounts.name: usdc_config
docs: 3. The USDC side's config: its pause, its mint and its fee account.

accounts.name: curve
docs: 4. A `CurveUsdc` by its type: a SOL `Curve` here is refused by its discriminator (3002).

accounts.name: usdc_vault
docs: 5. The curve's reserve, which pays the proceeds and the fee, the curve signing. Its balance is
never read: a sale is bounded by `real_usdc_reserves`, so USDC sent straight to it pays no one.

accounts.name: token_vault
docs: 6. Where the tokens sold go back: the curve PDA's associated token account of the mint.

accounts.name: fee_usdc_account
docs: 7. The fee wallet's USDC account: the 1% fee, out of `usdc_vault`.

accounts.name: usdc_mint
docs: 8. The USDC mint the config names, for `transfer_checked`.

accounts.name: token_mint
docs: 9. The curve's token mint, for `transfer_checked`.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: 10. Classic SPL Token: USDC and the curve's token are both classic mints.

instructions.name: set_curve_usdc_paused
docs: One USDC curve's pause, bound by its seeds, under the kill-switch's rule.

accounts.name: authority
docs: The pauser or the admin: the handler decides which may write what.

accounts.name: usdc_config
docs: Read for its two keys alone.

accounts.name: curve
docs: Bound by its seeds (`ConstraintSeeds` at any other address), unlike the SOL
`set_curve_paused`, which checks none; a SOL `Curve` fails its discriminator first (3002).

instructions.name: set_distributor_funder
docs: Hand a v1 month's close over to the dividend payer (2026-10-24, the
fee-wallet split): signed by its recorded funder, `new_funder` the payer
alone; nothing else moves.

accounts.name: funder
docs: The month's recorded funder: only who funded a month hands its close over.

instructions.name: set_distributor_v2_funder
docs: Hand a v2 month's close over to the dividend payer, as `set_distributor_funder` does a v1
month's: signed by its recorded funder, `new_funder` the payer alone; nothing else moves.

accounts.name: funder
docs: The month's recorded funder: only who funded a month hands its close over.

instructions.name: set_launch_guard_authority
docs: Name the key that may launch a curve without the launch cap
(docs/solana/PEPPER-CURVE-PROGRAM.md §5.2). All-zero lets nobody.

accounts.name: admin
docs: Pays `LaunchGuardConfig`'s rent the first time.

instructions.name: set_usdc_paused
docs: The USDC side's kill-switch: the pauser or the admin pauses, only the
admin unpauses (`NotPauser`).

accounts.name: authority
docs: The pauser or the admin: the handler decides which may write what.

instructions.name: set_usdc_raydium
docs: Write the Raydium addresses a graduation sends a curve's reserves to,
each `None` kept as it is, signed by the program's upgrade authority
alone, as its ProgramData records it (`Unauthorized` for any other key,
`UsdcConfig.admin` included, and for an immutable program): none written
all-zero (`RaydiumNotSet`); when the CPMM or the tier changes, the
`amm_config` the one the config will hold, owned by its CPMM, still at 1%
(`GraduationFeeTierChanged`) and creating pools (`PoolCreationDisabled`).

accounts.name: upgrade_authority
docs: The program's upgrade authority, as its ProgramData records it. Not `UsdcConfig.admin`.

accounts.name: program_data
docs: The program's ProgramData, the upgradeable loader's PDA of the program id (`ConstraintSeeds`
anywhere else, so another program's ProgramData, whoever holds it, is refused), owned by the
loader, whose `upgrade_authority_address` must be the signer: `Unauthorized` for any other
key, for an immutable program, which records none, and for a program loaded without the
upgradeable loader, which has no ProgramData. Read by hand, not as Anchor's
`Account<ProgramData>`, whose bincode decoding made the program about 60 KB larger

accounts.name: raydium_amm_config
docs: The CPMM's 1% fee tier, passed when the CPMM or the tier changes (`AccountMismatch` when it
is missing then) and read only then: at the tier's address once written, owned by the CPMM
once written, an `AmmConfig` at 1% still creating pools. Typed as Raydium's account, it
would need Raydium's crate, which pins Anchor 1.0.2.

instructions.name: set_vesting_beneficiary
docs: Hand an unclaimed fan-led vesting allocation to the creator who proved
they own the channel. Refuses any vesting account whose beneficiary is
no longer the keyless placeholder, so a real creator's allocation is
unreachable from here.

instructions.name: sync_curve_creator
docs: Copy a claimed fan-led vesting beneficiary into `Curve.creator`. Takes no
address: refuses unless `Curve.creator` is still the keyless placeholder
and the vesting has already been handed to a real wallet, so it can
neither touch a real creator nor write anything the vesting does not say.

accounts.name: vesting
docs: Read-only: the SOURCE of the value written. Never modified here.

instructions.name: sync_curve_creator_usdc
docs: `sync_curve_creator` on a `CurveUsdc`, signed by `GlobalConfig.admin`
as the SOL one: once, from the fan-led placeholder to the vesting
beneficiary a claim already set, taking no address.

accounts.name: vesting
docs: Read-only: the SOURCE of the value written. Never modified here.

accounts.name: curve
docs: A `CurveUsdc` by its type: a SOL `Curve` here is refused by its discriminator (3002), as
the SOL `sync_curve_creator` refuses this one.

instructions.name: update_usdc_config
docs: Change the USDC config's keys, signed by `UsdcConfig.admin`. `None`, or
no `new_fee_usdc_account`, leaves a field as it is.

accounts.name: admin
docs: `UsdcConfig.admin`: the Squad's vault once handed over.

accounts.name: global_config
docs: Read for one key, the fee account's owner, as at init.

accounts.name: new_fee_usdc_account
docs: The new fee account, absent to keep the one there: held to the init's rule, of
`usdc_config.usdc_mint` (`ConstraintTokenMint`), owned by `GlobalConfig.fanex_fee_wallet`
(`AccountMismatch`), then `fee_usdc_account_valid` (`FeeUsdcAccountInvalid`). An account, not
an argument: an address alone could be checked for none of it.

instructions.name: usdc_pause_sol
docs: The USDC pause of the whole SOL side (§10.3.3, Rick, 2026-10-23),
`GlobalConfig.paused = true`, signed by `UsdcConfig.pauser` alone. Takes
no value, so it cannot unpause: that stays `set_paused(false)`,
`GlobalConfig.admin`'s.

accounts.name: pauser
docs: `UsdcConfig.pauser`, the only key this instruction takes. It pays nothing.

accounts.name: usdc_config
docs: Read for its pauser alone, bound by its seeds (Anchor's 2006 anywhere else).

accounts.name: global_config
docs: The SOL side's config, bound by its seeds.

instructions.name: usdc_pause_sol_curve
docs: The USDC pause of one SOL curve, `Curve.paused = true`, bound by its
seeds, signed by `UsdcConfig.pauser` alone. Unpausing stays
`set_curve_paused(false)`.

accounts.name: pauser
docs: `UsdcConfig.pauser`, the only key this instruction takes. It pays nothing.

accounts.name: usdc_config
docs: Read for its pauser alone, bound by its seeds (Anchor's 2006 anywhere else).

accounts.name: curve
docs: A SOL `Curve`, bound by its seeds `["curve", curve.mint]` and its bump (Anchor's 2006 anywhere
else), unlike `set_curve_paused`, which checks none; a `CurveUsdc` fails its discriminator first
(3002), so a USDC curve is paused by `set_curve_usdc_paused` alone.

instructions.name: waive_launch_guard
docs: Launch the mint's curve without the launch cap: signed by the launch
guard authority, before the curve exists (§5.2).

accounts.name: payer
docs: The launcher: pays the waiver's rent, as it pays the launch.

accounts.name: mint
docs: address is read, as the seed of the curve and of the waiver.

accounts.name: curve
docs: its owner): a waiver is made with the launch, never on a live curve.

errors.name: GloballyPaused
errors.msg: Trading is globally halted by the Fanex kill-switch

errors.name: CurvePaused
errors.msg: This curve is paused

errors.name: NotBonding
errors.msg: Curve is not in the Bonding phase

types.name: ClaimStatus
docs: Marks a single (distributor, claimant) as claimed
(PDA: [CLAIM_SEED, distributor, claimant]). Existence == claimed.
⚠️ Two formats exist on chain. Accounts created before the A+D upgrade are
56 bytes and carry no `rent_payer` — their rent was paid by the claimant.
`close_claim_status` refunds by format: new accounts to the recorded
`rent_payer`, legacy ones to the `claimant`. `Account<ClaimStatus>` only
deserializes the new format, which is fine everywhere except that close
path — it parses manually for exactly this reason.

fields.name: rent_payer
docs: Who funded this account's rent-exemption (the Fanex sponsor wallet in
the ordinary flow) — where the rent returns on close.

types.name: ClaimStatusClosed
docs: A fan-led vesting allocation was handed to the creator who claimed the
channel. Emitted at most once per curve — the placeholder guard makes a
second one impossible.

types.name: CreateCurveParams
docs: Launch parameters. The curve *shape* (virtual reserves, supply split) is
computed off-chain by `lib/solana/presale-math.ts` and handed in here; the
program does not trust it blindly — it enforces every invariant below, so a
malformed launch can never be created on-chain.

fields.name: curve_token_supply
docs: Tokens for sale on the curve (initial `real_token_reserves`).

fields.name: migration_token_supply
docs: Tokens reserved to seed the Raydium CPMM at graduation.

fields.name: vesting_token_supply
docs: Tokens vested to the creator (2%-15% of total supply; see `validation`).

fields.name: vesting_cliff_seconds
docs: Seconds before ANY vesting is releasable. `revenue` passes ~360d.

fields.name: vesting_duration_seconds
docs: Linear release window after the cliff. `0` = lump-sum (today's behaviour).

types.name: CreateCurveUsdcParams
docs: The launch's terms, computed by the server and checked here, as `CreateCurveParams` is: in µUSDC
where today's are in lamports, the two splits a u16 as `CurveUsdc` keeps them.

fields.name: graduation_threshold_usdc
docs: The curve's USDC that ends the bonding phase and seeds the pool: today's `cpmm_seed_lamports`.

fields.name: curve_token_supply
docs: Tokens for sale on the curve (the first `real_token_reserves`).

fields.name: migration_token_supply
docs: Tokens kept to seed the pool at graduation.

fields.name: vesting_token_supply
docs: Tokens vested to the creator.

fields.name: symbol
docs: At most `MAX_USDC_SYMBOL_LEN` (10) bytes, Metaplex's own limit.

types.name: CreatorRaiseClosedUsdc
docs: 80 bytes: `close_creator_raise_usdc`, `UsdcConfig.admin` closing a USDC curve's creator raise at
what it has received, so its buys no longer need the creator's USDC account (one frozen or lost
would stop them for good). `creator_cap_usdc` is the cap after the close, the creator's received.

types.name: Curve
docs: Per-token bonding curve (PDA: [CURVE_SEED, mint]).

fields.name: mint
docs: The SPL mint this curve trades.

fields.name: creator
docs: Creator wallet — receives the 94% atomic split + vesting.

fields.name: creator_target_lamports
docs: Gross creator target in lamports (includes the 6% Fanex fee). >= 16 SOL.

fields.name: cpmm_seed_lamports
docs: SOL routed into the curve that triggers graduation + seeds the CPMM.

fields.name: creator_split_bps
docs: Per-buy split, applied to the buyer's SOL until the caps below fill.

fields.name: creator_cap_lamports
docs: Hard caps: total creator/Fanex SOL ever taken (0.94×target / 0.06×target).

fields.name: real_sol_reserves
docs: SOL actually collected into the curve (withdrawable at graduation).

fields.name: real_token_reserves
docs: Tokens remaining for sale on the curve.

fields.name: migration_token_reserves
docs: Tokens reserved to seed the Raydium CPMM at graduation.

fields.name: paused
docs: Per-curve pause (independent of the global kill-switch).

types.name: CurveCreatedUsdc
docs: 88 bytes.

types.name: CurveCreatorSynced
docs: `Curve.creator` moved off the fan-led placeholder, copied from the vesting
beneficiary a claim already set (`sync_curve_creator`).

types.name: CurvePhase
docs: Bonding-curve lifecycle. Mirrors `solana_curves.current_phase` off-chain.

types.name: CurveUsdc
docs: A curve priced in USDC (PDA: [CURVE_SEED, mint], the address a SOL `Curve`
would take: a mint has one or the other), 354 bytes on chain (8 + 346).
Another account type, so every SOL instruction refuses it by its
discriminator (3002) and every USDC instruction refuses a `Curve` alike.
USDC amounts in µUSDC, token amounts in base units; each field keeps its
SOL twin's meaning. Unlike `Curve`, the bumps come first.

fields.name: version
docs: Layout version: 1.

fields.name: usdc_vault_bump
docs: The bump of the curve's USDC vault, [USDC_VAULT_SEED, mint].

fields.name: phase
docs: A raw u8 read through `constants::PHASE_*` (0 Bonding, 1 Graduating,
2 Graduated, 3 PoolCreated), never `CurvePhase`, which stays the SOL
enum as it is.

fields.name: paused
docs: Per-curve pause: stops this curve's two swaps and its graduation.

fields.name: migrated
docs: A curve converted from SOL (the migration, USDC curve design §10.10).

fields.name: creator
docs: As `Curve.creator`: the fee beneficiary, the fan-led placeholder until
the claim.

fields.name: creator_usdc_account
docs: Where the creator's raise split is paid; all-zero when
`creator_split_bps` is 0.

fields.name: creator_split_bps
docs: Narrowed from `Curve`'s u64: validation keeps each under 10 000.

fields.name: graduation_threshold_usdc
docs: The pool seed that triggers the graduation: `Curve.cpmm_seed_lamports`.

fields.name: real_usdc_reserves
docs: A counter: the vault's balance is never read for a price, so a donation
to the vault moves nothing.

fields.name: created_at
docs: A migrated curve keeps its SOL birth.

fields.name: migrated_at
docs: 0 for a curve born in USDC.

types.name: Distributor
docs: A funded monthly dividend distribution (PDA: [DISTRIBUTOR_SEED, mint, month]).
Holds the SOL to be claimed; `merkle_root` commits to (claimant, amount).

fields.name: month
docs: Off-chain period key (e.g. YYYYMM as a little-endian u32 in an i64).

fields.name: funder
docs: Who funded it (allowed to reclaim leftovers after expiry).

fields.name: expires_at
docs: Unix time after which the funder may reclaim unclaimed SOL.

types.name: DistributorFunderSet
docs: A v1 month's close handed over (`set_distributor_funder`, 2026-10-24): `funder`
closes it from now on, in `previous`'s place.

types.name: DistributorV2
docs: A funded monthly dividend distribution that records its claims itself
(PDA: [DISTRIBUTOR_SEED, mint, month], the same address a v1 `Distributor`
would take, so a month has one distributor whichever its version).
One bit per Merkle leaf, set by `claim_dividend_v2`: a claim creates no
account, so it costs only the network fee. The funder pays the bitmap once,
inside this account's rent, and gets it back at close. The v1 fields come
first, at the v1 offsets, so an off-chain reader that needs only totals,
funder and expiry decodes both versions alike; the discriminator tells them
apart, and every instruction refuses the other version's account.

fields.name: month
docs: Off-chain period key (YYYYMM), as in `Distributor`.

fields.name: merkle_root
docs: Root over v2 leaves (`math::dividend_leaf_v2`): each leaf binds its index.

fields.name: funder
docs: Who funded it (allowed to close it, as in `Distributor`).

fields.name: leaf_count
docs: Leaves the root commits to; `claimed` holds one bit for each.

fields.name: claimed
docs: Bit `index % 8` of byte `index / 8` is set once leaf `index` has claimed
(`validation::leaf_bit`). Exactly `ceil(leaf_count / 8)` bytes.

types.name: GlobalConfig
docs: Singleton program config (PDA: [CONFIG_SEED]).

fields.name: admin
docs: Admin authority allowed to update config + toggle the global pause; since
2026-10-24 (the fee-wallet split) also the Metaplex update authority of
every SOL token launched (`create_curve`).

fields.name: fanex_fee_wallet
docs: Where `buy` and `sell` pay Fanex: the 1% platform swap fee on every trade
and a buy's share of the raise. Read by those two alone since 2026-10-24
(the fee-wallet split): receive-only, it signs and authorizes nothing.

fields.name: graduation_authority
docs: Keeper authority permitted to call `graduate` (release liquidity); since
2026-10-24 also the approver of every v2 dividend month and the only
funder of a v1 one.

fields.name: paused
docs: On-chain hard kill-switch. When true, create/buy/sell/distribute halt.

types.name: GraduatedUsdc
docs: 112 bytes: `graduate_usdc_lock`, the second step.

types.name: GraduationPoolCreated
docs: 96 bytes: `graduate_usdc_pool`, the first graduation step.

fields.name: lp_amount
docs: Read from the LP account after the CPI.

types.name: GraduationReadyUsdc
docs: 48 bytes: the buy that froze the curve at its threshold.

types.name: InitializeUsdcConfigParams
docs: The keys `initialize_usdc_config` writes beside its accounts: every role but the admin, which is
an account so that its owner is checked. The USDC mint and the fee account come as accounts too,
so the program checks what they are.

fields.name: pauser
docs: May only pause: a hot key, so a pause stays fast.

fields.name: migration_authority
docs: Signs the migration permits of the SOL curves (§10.10); all-zero, nobody.

fields.name: lp_fee_owner
docs: Receives a graduated pool's Fee Key, so it harvests the LP fees (§10.3.9); never all-zero
(`LpFeeOwnerUnset`).

fields.name: launcher
docs: The only payer `create_curve_usdc` takes: the sponsor (Rick, 2026-10-22, §10.3.4).

types.name: LaunchGuardConfig
docs: Who may launch a curve without the launch cap (PDA: [LAUNCH_GUARD_SEED],
2026-10-14), set by `config.admin` through `set_launch_guard_authority`.
An all-zero `authority` lets nobody: no key signs for it.

types.name: LaunchGuardWaiver
docs: A curve launched without the launch cap (PDA: [LAUNCH_GUARD_WAIVER_SEED,
mint], 2026-10-14). Only `waive_launch_guard` makes one, signed by
`LaunchGuardConfig.authority`, before the curve exists; `buy` skips the cap
when it is passed as an extra account (`validation::launch_guard_waived`).
Never closed.

types.name: SetUsdcRaydiumParams
docs: The Raydium addresses to write, each `None` to keep the one the config holds: the first call
names all five, a later one only what Raydium moved.

fields.name: raydium_cpmm_program
docs: Raydium's CPMM program: mainnet `CPMMoo8L…`, devnet `DRaycpLY…`.

fields.name: raydium_amm_config
docs: The CPMM's 1% fee tier: mainnet index 1 `G95xxie3…`, devnet index 3.

fields.name: raydium_create_pool_fee
docs: The account CPMM's `initialize` takes its pool-creation fee into: CPMM binds it itself, so
only clients read it.

fields.name: raydium_lock_program
docs: Raydium's LP lock program: mainnet `LockrWmn…`, devnet `DRay25Us…`.

fields.name: raydium_lock_authority
docs: The LP lock's authority PDA.

types.name: SolVault
docs: Program-owned lamport vault for a curve's SOL reserves
(PDA: [SOL_VAULT_SEED, mint]). Holds rent + `real_sol_reserves`.

fields.name: is_buy
docs: true = buy (SOL in, tokens out); false = sell (tokens in, SOL out).

fields.name: platform_fee
docs: 1% platform swap fee paid to Fanex (separate from the fundraise share).

types.name: TradeUsdc
docs: 161 bytes. ⚠️ Neither `authority` nor `token_owner` is the end user of a
routed trade: in a router's shared-accounts route both are the router's
authority. The indexer records a trade only when `authority` signed it and
owns the destination (buy) or the source (sale), and drops any other.

fields.name: authority
docs: Account 0 of the swap, its signer.

fields.name: token_owner
docs: The owner of the destination token account (buy) or the source (sale).

fields.name: is_buy
docs: true = buy (USDC in, tokens out); false = sell (tokens in, USDC out).

fields.name: usdc_amount
docs: On a buy everything charged; on a sale the gross, before the fee, as
`Trade.sol_amount`.

fields.name: platform_fee
docs: The 1% platform swap fee.

types.name: UsdcConfig
docs: The USDC curve's config (PDA: [USDC_CONFIG_SEED]), 491 bytes on chain
(8 + 483). `GlobalConfig` has no spare byte, hence a second config; the USDC
side reads `GlobalConfig` for a key only, never for money, pauses or fees.

fields.name: version
docs: Layout version: 1.

fields.name: paused
docs: The USDC side's kill-switch: stops `create_curve_usdc`, both swaps and
both graduation steps, never the vesting or the admin instructions.

fields.name: admin
docs: Changes the config and unpauses (the Squad's vault once handed over);
the Metaplex update authority of every token launched on the USDC curve.

fields.name: pauser
docs: The USDC pause's one key: may only pause, the USDC side and, through
`usdc_pause_sol` and `usdc_pause_sol_curve`, the SOL side; a hot key,
so a pause stays fast.

fields.name: migration_authority
docs: Signs the migration permits of the SOL curves; all-zero, nobody.

fields.name: usdc_mint
docs: Set once, at `initialize_usdc_config`.

fields.name: fee_usdc_account
docs: The fee wallet's USDC account: every fee and Fanex share lands there.
Its associated account, not frozen, closable only by this config's PDA
(the internal audit, 2026-10-29: `validation::fee_usdc_account_valid`), so
the fee wallet sweeps it and never closes it under the swaps.

fields.name: lp_fee_owner
docs: Receives a graduated pool's Fee Key, so it harvests the LP fees.

fields.name: raydium_amm_config
docs: The 1% fee tier the graduation seeds its pool on.

fields.name: raydium_create_pool_fee
docs: The account Raydium's `initialize` takes its pool-creation fee into.

fields.name: raydium_lock_authority
docs: The LP lock's authority PDA.

fields.name: launcher
docs: The only key `create_curve_usdc` takes as its payer: the sponsor.

fields.name: reserved
docs: 128 until `launcher` took 32 of them (2026-10-22).

types.name: UsdcConfigUpdated
docs: 200 bytes: the config's keys after `initialize_usdc_config` or
`update_usdc_config`.

types.name: UsdcPauseSet
docs: 73 bytes.

fields.name: curve
docs: All-zero for the global pause.

types.name: UsdcPauseSolSet
docs: 72 bytes: `usdc_pause_sol` or `usdc_pause_sol_curve`, the USDC pause of the SOL
side, signed by `UsdcConfig.pauser`. The SOL pauses of `GlobalConfig.admin`,
`set_paused` and `set_curve_paused`, emit nothing, so this names only the
pauser's. There is no `paused` field: these two only ever write `true`.

fields.name: curve
docs: The SOL `Curve` paused; all-zero for the whole SOL side (`GlobalConfig.paused`).

types.name: UsdcRaydiumSet
docs: 200 bytes: `set_usdc_raydium`, the five addresses as set.

types.name: Vesting
docs: Creator vesting schedule (PDA: [VESTING_SEED, mint]).
